title: Forbidden Actions Registry
description: Canonical list of actions an automated agent MUST NOT perform without explicit per-action human authorisation. Absorbs LAW-12.FORBID.1 from the stech-law predecessor draft (D-38). The default registry ships with DEVAI at .devai/config/forbidden-actions.json; clients may extend (never relax) it.

waivers.description: D-123 (item 6): explicit, reasoned exceptions for canonical entries this repo intentionally does not carry. A canonical id absent from `actions` AND absent from `waivers` is reported by `devai policy check forbidden actions`'s coverage check as an unwaived gap — extend the registry, never silently drop protections it ships with.

id.description: The canonical FORBID-* id being waived.

reason.description: Why this repo does not carry this canonical protection. Forensic trail, not a rubber stamp.

action.description: Short imperative description, e.g. 'force-push to any branch'.

detect_patterns.description: Regex patterns (as strings) the scanner uses to detect violations in commit messages, recent commands, or reflog entries.
